detailed_records.claim_text: Patients receiving Compound-X demonstrated a 12.1% reduction in 30-day mortality [1]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In a double-blind, randomized controlled trial involving 1,450 patients, patients receiving Compound-X demonstrated a 12.1% reduction in 30-day mortality compared with the placebo arm (p = 0.003). Adverse events were similar across both groups.

detailed_records.claim_text: LearnFast software increased student test scores [4]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Background: Educational software interventions were evaluated. In our pilot evaluation involving 40 students with no control group, test scores increased by 12.1%.

detailed_records.claim_text: The Transformer model achieved a score of 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task [5]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: On the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, the big transformer model achieves a state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4, outperforming the best previously reported models, including ensembles, by more than 2.0 BLEU. The model was trained on 8 P100 GPUs.

detailed_records.claim_text: Pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy improved median progression-free survival to 8.8 months compared with 4.2 months for chemotherapy alone [2]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer, the addition of pembrolizumab to standard chemotherapy resulted in significantly longer overall survival. The median progression-free survival was 8.8 months in the pembrolizumab-combination group versus 4.2 months in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for disease progression, 0.52; p < 0.001).

detailed_records.claim_text: Colloidal perovskite quantum dots achieved a photoluminescence quantum yield of 92.5% at room temperature [7]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Colloidal cesium lead halide perovskite nanocrystals exhibit bright photoluminescence. We synthesize monodisperse nanocrystals demonstrating photoluminescence quantum yields reaching 92.5% at room temperature without the need for post-synthetic surface shell growth.

detailed_records.claim_text: Lecanemab therapy reduced brain amyloid plaque burden by 41.2% at 18 months [3]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In this 18-month multicenter phase 3 trial in early Alzheimer's disease, intravenous lecanemab reduced brain amyloid burden on PET imaging by 41.2% relative to placebo (difference: -59.1 centiloids, p < 0.001). Infusion-related reactions occurred in 26.4% of participants.

detailed_records.claim_text: Cas9 ribonucleoprotein delivery achieved 68.4% targeted gene disruption in primary T cells [6]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Electroporation of recombinant Cas9 ribonucleoproteins into stimulated primary human T cells achieved targeted gene disruption frequencies of up to 68.4% at the CXCR4 locus. Off-target cleavage was below 0.5% across predicted genomic homologous sites.

detailed_records.claim_text: The mRNA-1273 vaccine demonstrated 94.1% efficacy against symptomatic illness in a trial of 30,420 participants [8]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: The trial enrolled 30,420 volunteers who were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio. Symptomatic illness occurred in 185 participants in the placebo group and in 11 participants in the mRNA-1273 group.

detailed_records.claim_text: Perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells reached a certified power conversion efficiency of 29.8% [9]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem architectures enable low-cost, high-efficiency photovoltaics. Here we report a certified power conversion efficiency of 29.8% for a tandem device, enabled by self-assembled methyl-substituted carbazole hole-selective monolayers.

detailed_records.claim_text: The DASH diet reduced systolic blood pressure by 5.5 mmHg compared with the control diet [10]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In 459 adults with systolic blood pressure of less than 160 mm Hg, the combination DASH diet reduced systolic blood pressure by 5.5 mmHg (p < 0.001) and diastolic blood pressure by 3.0 mmHg (p < 0.001) more than the control diet.

detailed_records.claim_text: Lanthanum hydride exhibited superconductivity at a critical temperature of 250 K under 170 GPa pressure [11]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: We synthesized lanthanum hydride (LaH10) in diamond anvil cells and observed electrical resistance dropping sharply to zero at a critical temperature of 250 K at 170 GPa. The upper critical magnetic field was estimated to exceed 120 tesla at low temperatures.

detailed_records.claim_text: Doppler measurements detected a planet orbiting Proxima Centauri with a minimum mass of 1.17 Earth masses [12]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: High-precision radial velocity observations from ESPRESSO confirmed the presence of Proxima b. The planet has an orbital period of 11.2 days and a minimum mass of 1.17 Earth masses (± 0.19 Earth masses), orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf host star.

detailed_records.claim_text: Microcredit expansion showed no significant effect on average business profits across 104 urban slums [13]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: We report on a randomized evaluation of microcredit in Hyderabad, India. While borrowing increased, we find no significant effect of access to microfinance on average business profits, average monthly consumption, or female empowerment measures.

detailed_records.claim_text: A multi-lab replication of the ego depletion effect observed an effect size of d = 0.04 across 23 laboratories [14]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In a registered replication report encompassing 23 laboratories and 2,141 participants, the observed meta-analytic effect size for ego depletion was d = 0.04 (95% CI: -0.07 to 0.15). The result was statistically indistinguishable from zero across all testing sites.

detailed_records.claim_text: Antarctic ice core data demonstrated atmospheric carbon dioxide levels remained between 180 and 280 ppm over the past 800,000 years [15]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Analysis of air bubbles trapped in the EPICA Dome C Antarctic ice core reveals that atmospheric CO2 concentrations fluctuated strictly within 180 to 280 ppm throughout the past 800,000 years, establishing that modern CO2 concentrations exceed pre-industrial baselines.

detailed_records.claim_text: Patients receiving Compound-X demonstrated a 12.1% reduction in 30-day mortality [1]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In a double-blind, randomized controlled trial involving 1,450 patients, patients receiving Compound-X demonstrated a 12.1% reduction in 30-day mortality compared with the placebo arm (p = 0.003). Adverse events were similar across both groups.

detailed_records.claim_text: LearnFast software increased student test scores [4]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Background: Educational software interventions were evaluated. In our pilot evaluation involving 40 students with no control group, test scores increased by 12.1%.

detailed_records.claim_text: The Transformer model achieved a score of 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task [5]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: On the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, the big transformer model achieves a state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4, outperforming the best previously reported models, including ensembles, by more than 2.0 BLEU. The model was trained on 8 P100 GPUs.

detailed_records.claim_text: Pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy improved median progression-free survival to 8.8 months compared with 4.2 months for chemotherapy alone [2]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer, the addition of pembrolizumab to standard chemotherapy resulted in significantly longer overall survival. The median progression-free survival was 8.8 months in the pembrolizumab-combination group versus 4.2 months in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for disease progression, 0.52; p < 0.001).

detailed_records.claim_text: Colloidal perovskite quantum dots achieved a photoluminescence quantum yield of 92.5% at room temperature [7]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Colloidal cesium lead halide perovskite nanocrystals exhibit bright photoluminescence. We synthesize monodisperse nanocrystals demonstrating photoluminescence quantum yields reaching 92.5% at room temperature without the need for post-synthetic surface shell growth.

detailed_records.claim_text: Lecanemab therapy reduced brain amyloid plaque burden by 41.2% at 18 months [3]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In this 18-month multicenter phase 3 trial in early Alzheimer's disease, intravenous lecanemab reduced brain amyloid burden on PET imaging by 41.2% relative to placebo (difference: -59.1 centiloids, p < 0.001). Infusion-related reactions occurred in 26.4% of participants.

detailed_records.claim_text: Cas9 ribonucleoprotein delivery achieved 68.4% targeted gene disruption in primary T cells [6]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Electroporation of recombinant Cas9 ribonucleoproteins into stimulated primary human T cells achieved targeted gene disruption frequencies of up to 68.4% at the CXCR4 locus. Off-target cleavage was below 0.5% across predicted genomic homologous sites.

detailed_records.claim_text: The mRNA-1273 vaccine demonstrated 94.1% efficacy against symptomatic illness in a trial of 30,420 participants [8]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: The trial enrolled 30,420 volunteers who were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio. Symptomatic illness occurred in 185 participants in the placebo group and in 11 participants in the mRNA-1273 group.

detailed_records.claim_text: Perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells reached a certified power conversion efficiency of 29.8% [9]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem architectures enable low-cost, high-efficiency photovoltaics. Here we report a certified power conversion efficiency of 29.8% for a tandem device, enabled by self-assembled methyl-substituted carbazole hole-selective monolayers.

detailed_records.claim_text: The DASH diet reduced systolic blood pressure by 5.5 mmHg compared with the control diet [10]
detailed_records.evidence_quotation: In 459 adults with systolic blood pressure of less than 160 mm Hg, the combination DASH diet reduced systolic blood pressure by 5.5 mmHg (p < 0.001) and diastolic blood pressure by 3.0 mmHg (p < 0.001) more than the control diet.
